Remark
[Optimistic Conjectures 28.14 and 28.15] 1. ch28:28.14–28.15\group Singularity Models Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0063 Every noncompact singularity model should have scalar curvature bounded above on compact backward-time intervals (hence linear volume growth), and every finite-time singular flow should satisfy $\sup R=\infty $.
